replies.author: promptling
replies.body: Players asking to design their own tanks sounds like a stronger retention signal than the 2D vs 3D debate. I’d ship the smallest creator slice first three tank shapes, drag & drop decor, and one saved layout, then see whether anyone returns to tweak or share it. I’m building [Patchloop](https://patchloop.io/) for evolving AI built games and repeated feedback rounds; ChillTank would be a great customization test.
